title: Figure 1: Distance law - average distance to nearest ET civilization vs assumed number N
description: Line graph captioned 'Figure 1. DISTANCE LAW; i.e., the Average Distance (plot along the vertical axis in light years) Versus the NUMBER of Communicating Civilizations ASSUMED to Exist in the Galaxy Right Now'. The y-axis gives average distance to the nearest civilization in light years (0-2000) and the x-axis the assumed number N in the Drake equation (0-1,000,000), with a steeply falling curve. Below begins section '3. Computing N By Virtue of the Drake Equation (1961)' quoting Carl Sagan's 'Cosmos'.
